comment: setActionBar call sites with no realm:actionbar request in their function or a helper (file -> function names). build_bp (social-world track): notes from the Effortless Building port that skip lockActionBar. elytra_bp triggerNosRocket: the NOS hint. hud_bp and stats_bp (anonymous): the Coordinates HUD and the stats ticker are the lowest steady lines, which only listen and wait (by design, but their redraw could announce a rank too); stats_bp clearTicker and hud_bp onChange clear the bar with an empty string, which can wipe another pack note. stash_bp (top level): the default hook that main.js replaces. Remove a line with its fix.
